title: Nile Red Staining of Drosophila Larval Tissues
author: Elizabeth Allen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5x7g7rn

steps.title: Dissect tissues
steps.instruction: Dissect tissues in ice cold 1X PBS, keeping samples on ice until the required sample size is obtained.

steps.title: Fix tissues
steps.instruction: Fix the dissected tissues in 4% PFA for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Wash tissues
steps.instruction: Wash the tissues 3 times in 1X PBS.

steps.title: Stain with Nile Red
steps.instruction: Stain samples in Nile Red (prepared in acetone) at a concentration of 0.5 ug/mL diluted in PBS for 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash tissues
steps.instruction: Wash the tissues 3 times in 1X PBS.

steps.title: Mount and image samples
steps.instruction: Carefully replace the PBS with mounting medium, transfer samples to slides, and image.

substeps.instruction: Image immediately or temporarily store slides at 4°C.
